title: scct.stages version 2 (zones / sectors)
description: A zones plan (Reloaded.Editor/StageModel.h; Map Design Tools > Zones..., bridge ops stage.read, stage.preview and stage.apply). The map's top SMission (GM_Multi, bChained True) holds one zone mission per zone in match order; each zone mission (Tag Zone<N>Mission, GM_Undefined, bChained False) holds that zone's SObjectives, all live when the zone starts, and its MinimumObjectives is how many end the zone. A zone's completion fires one SMagicEvent tagged Zone<N>_Complete whose group holds the actions. Objectives are named by actor path, so a plan belongs to the map it came from. Every objective in the map must be in exactly one zone. Checks this schema cannot express: an objective in two zones, a zone's required above its objective count, the plan's required above all objectives.

version.description: Version 1 plans (the earlier counting-event window) are refused; rebuild them from the map.

required.description: Objectives the spies need to win the match (the top mission's MinimumObjectives); 0 means every zone's threshold added up.

mission.description: Path of the top mission (as read back from the map).

line.description: Up to 200 characters on one line.

delay.description: Seconds after the zone completes, 0-86400, as a string.

brief.description: Spy briefing: the zone mission's Description (default "Complete the objectives").

objectives.description: SObjective actor paths; apply refuses an empty zone.

required.description: How many of the zone's objectives end it (MinimumObjectives); 0 means all of them.

mission.description: Path of an existing SMission to use as this zone's mission (otherwise one tagged Zone<N>Mission, or a new one).

oneOf.description: Open a door or lift (trigger a mover); with hold (default true) a timed door is switched to TriggerToggle so it stays open.
Fire an existing sound trigger (target), or make a SoundTrigger Zone<N>_Sound<i> for a loaded sound asset.
Show a banner on both HUDs: an SAlarm Zone<N>_Announce that locks and triggers nothing.
Trigger (or untrigger) any other actor by path, or any Tag.
